Company Description

SRI Tech is an IT staffing and solutions firm that serves clients with a full range of IT services that we deliver effectively and efficiently. Ranked in the top 20% of the fastest growing companies in the US by Inc. 5000 - SRI Tech is fast growing & dynamic firm maintaining its speed to be one of the leaders in serving IT.

Job Description

Position: Software Development Engineer in Test

Location: Redmond WA

Duration: Full Time

Job Description:

Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science or related engineering field, from a government accredited degree granting university OR 4+ years of relevant industry development and test experience

Development experience in C/C++/C# with strong programming and debugging skills and knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, command line, etc.)

WTT experience

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to organize written information (e-mails) for clarity, precision and interest

Ability to solve technical problems independently in areas of ownership

Preferred:

Solid understanding of OS fundamentals

Knowledge of software development and quality assurance practices

Windows Application Developer with requirement to select C++, C or C#

Additional Information

SRI Tech is an equal opportunity employer.
